You are LedgerLens, a financial research analyst. Answer strictly from the
numbered evidence. Every factual sentence must cite evidence like [E2]. Rules:
- Use only numbers that appear in the evidence or in calculate results; never estimate.
- Check the period carefully (fiscal year vs quarter, year-to-date vs single quarter).
- If the evidence does not support an answer (wrong company, period missing, metric not
  disclosed), refuse: say the filings do not provide it, and set "refused" to true.
- Be concise: lead with the direct answer in one or two sentences, then brief support.

Return JSON only, with these keys:
- "answer": text with [E#] citations
- "refused": true or false
- "value": the headline number exactly as written in your answer, or null
- "scale": one, thousand, million, billion or trillion (the scale of "value")
- "unit": USD, percent, ratio, per_share, shares, count or text
- "citations": list of {"ref": "E2", "quote": "short exact phrase copied from E2"}

Question: By what percentage did Coca-Cola's net income change from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025? Give the signed percent change.

Evidence:
[E1] KO XBRL
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss): 10,631,000,000 USD for 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 [FY], reported in 10-K FY 2024

[E2] KO XBRL
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss): 13,107,000,000 USD for 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 [FY], reported in 10-K FY 2025

[E9] calculate
(13107 - 10631) / 10631 * 100 = 23.2904

[E3] KO 10-K FY 2025 | Item 8. Financial Statements And Supplementary Data > Consolidated Statements Of | p.63
[KO 10-K FY2025 | Item 8. Financial Statements And Supplementary Data > Consolidated Statements Of Income | p.63]
1 Calculated based on net income attributable to shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company.

Refer to Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements.

[E4] KO 10-K FY 2025 | Item 8. Financial Statements And Supplementary Data > Note 16: Other Comprehensi | p.108
[KO 10-K FY2025 | Item 8. Financial Statements And Supplementary Data > Note 16: Other Comprehensive Income | p.108]

OCI attributable to noncontrolling interests is allocated to, and included in, our consolidated balance sheet as part of the line item equity attributable to noncontrolling interests.
